human_reorganization: Complete bases are proved by exponential generating functions and entire-transform uniqueness; the formal Charlier proof uses algebraic ladder spanning and the verified Poisson polynomial-density infrastructure.
The paper uses scalar annihilation sqrt(lambda)*Delta. Original formal fields have measure lambda*Poisson; weightedScalarEquiv identifies their norms and the creation graph.
Full weighted sequence domains and weak-distributional Gaussian characterizations are reconstructed analytically from the mapped spectral graphs; they are not new Lean declarations.
The nonpositive image of the count function is an elementary deduction, not a separately mapped verified theorem. The product counterexample uses the exact mapped square decomposition.

The half-density cocycle, Gaussian unitary change of variables and dense open-interval coherent span identify the physical action. The formal proof instead uses closed physical-formula domains, coherent density and source-independent graph uniqueness.

Finite-support graph cores are proved with the exact difference-of-output boundary formulas; the formal proof uses a different cutoff decomposition. The entropy proof specializes to explicit roots and verifies the remaining boundary factorial tail.
Strong continuity is Hilbert norm continuity for each fixed vector; the operator norm lower bound is only sqrt(2) at positive displacement. No optimal norm value is claimed.
All correspondence, displacement and quadratic logarithmic Sobolev mechanisms are treated as classical; no new Fock correspondence or Poisson logarithmic Sobolev counterexample is claimed.

The sharp 1/2 curvature calculation is reconstructed by neighboring differences and an explicit five-square polynomial decomposition, including k=0,1. Sharpness on finite-support tests is a local cutoff deduction from the mapped count witness, not a separate formal declaration. The integrated core energy, chain-rule failure and forward-energy distinction are separately mapped.

literature.review: Vershik--Tsilevich 2003 primary full PDF: Sections 1.3 and 3.1 explicitly cover the canonical correspondence, nonpositivity/nonmultiplicativity and one-point Hermite--Charlier specialization.

Aryan--Lopez-Rivera--Shenfeld 2025 v2 primary full PDF: introduction credits classical quadratic failure; Theorem 1.1 and Section 4 give the modified Wu inequality and exponential equality cases. Exact displacement/graph exposition has no independent priority certification.

Weber--Zacher primary full preprint, Example 5.13 and discussion on p35, already treats the Poisson process as an example with CD(1/2,infinity) but no positive entropy-adapted CD_Upsilon bound. This is an explicit classical antecedent, not a novel curvature/entropy separation.
